title: graceful_failure records why the run stopped
intent: Pin the failure writer's request: the artifact names the node that refused and the reason, so a stopped run is diagnosable from disk.

input.featureRequest: Accept a new optional config block and validate it.

artifact.reason: gate_syntax refused: the generated file does not parse
artifact.detail: The run stopped at gate_syntax: gate_syntax refused: the generated file does not parse.

expected.notes: .bober/failures/ is not one of the eleven conformance fields, so the artifact map is empty and the pinned REQUEST carries the assertion. A failure writer called with an empty reason would fail this case.
